product_name: Dark Chocolate Almond Crunch Protein Bar

allergen_requirements.rule: Per FDA FALCPA regulations, tree nuts used as recipe ingredients (Almonds) must be explicitly disclosed in the ingredients list and declared in a 'Contains: Almonds' statement. Generic 'May contain nuts' advisory alone is a statutory violation.

net_quantity_rules.rule: Per 21 CFR § 101.105, net quantity on the Principal Display Panel must display dual units (US Customary ounces + metric grams): '60g (2.12 oz)'. Displaying metric grams alone fails US food labeling requirements.

unapproved_claims_flag: No drug, disease prevention, or unapproved structure/function claims are permitted.
storage_text: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
